name: EcoDev Agent Chat
author: ecodevbf

sections.description:
EcoDev Agent Chat adds a chat bubble to your site so that your visitors can talk to the AI assistant of your business, set up with EcoDev Agents. The assistant knows your catalogue, prices, delivery areas and FAQ, reads the products published in your WooCommerce shop, and hands the conversation over to you when a human is needed (order to confirm, complaint, unanswered question).

  • Lightweight chat bubble, no external library, mobile friendly and keyboard accessible.
  • Works with WooCommerce: the assistant answers with the products, prices and stock published in your shop.
  • Title, welcome message, colour and position can be set from the EcoDev Agents console or from Settings → EcoDev Agent Chat.
  • The bubble hides itself when the assistant is not connected, so visitors never write into the void.
  • Visitors’ messages are stored in your own WordPress database and deleted after 30 days.
  • Each visitor can only read their own conversation, thanks to a key signed by your site.

How it works

  1. A visitor writes in the chat bubble. The message is saved in a table of your WordPress database.
  2. Your EcoDev Agents assistant, which you connected to your site with an application password, reads the new messages through your site’s REST API (every few seconds), writes an answer and posts it back to your site.
  3. The bubble shows the answer to the visitor.

The plugin itself never sends data anywhere: it is the assistant that connects to your site, with the access you gave it.

External services

This plugin is the website side of the EcoDev Agents service (https://ecodev.dev), operated by ECODEV INTERNATIONAL. It only works with an EcoDev Agents assistant.

  • What is used: the EcoDev Agents assistant connected to your site.
  • What data: the text of the messages written by visitors in the chat bubble, the address of the page where they wrote, and a random identifier of the conversation (no name, e-mail or IP address).
  • When: every few seconds while the chatbot is enabled, the assistant reads the unanswered messages from your site’s REST API, processes them on the EcoDev servers (including with an AI language model) to write the answer, and posts the answer back to your site.
  • Privacy policy: https://ecodev.dev/politique-de-confidentialite/
sections.installation:
1. In the EcoDev Agents console, connect your WordPress site to your assistant (channel “WordPress / WooCommerce”), then enable the chatbot. If the assistant’s WordPress account is an Administrator, the assistant installs and sets up this plugin by itself.
  2. Otherwise, install this plugin from Plugins → Add New and activate it. Then, in Settings → EcoDev Agent Chat, choose the assistant’s account under “Assistant account”: the assistant finds the plugin and sets it up within a minute.
sections.faq:
Do I need an EcoDev Agents account?

Yes. The plugin is the chat window; the answers are written by your EcoDev Agents assistant. Without an assistant connected to your site, the bubble stays hidden.

Where are the messages stored?

In the wp_ecodev_chat table of your WordPress database (with your table prefix). Messages older than 30 days are deleted. Deleting the plugin removes the table and its settings.

Which WordPress account does the assistant use?

The account whose application password you gave to the assistant in the EcoDev Agents console. Only Administrators and the account chosen in Settings → EcoDev Agent Chat (“Assistant account”) can read visitors’ messages, answer them and change the chat settings. You can revoke the application password at any time from Users → Profile → Application Passwords.

Can visitors abuse the chat?

Each IP address can send up to 20 messages every 10 minutes, and messages are limited to 1,000 characters.

  • The assistant’s routes are limited to Administrators and to the account chosen in the settings.
  • Each visitor reads their conversation with a key signed by the site.
  • Translations are now provided by translate.wordpress.org.

1.0.0

  • First version.
